headline: Discussed budget deficit drivers and possible revenue and savings options at first meeting
summary: The Deficit Reduction Committee held its first meeting and introduced members, including Madeline Lennox, Kaarin Robinson, Mark Munoz, John Mullady, Christine de Palma, Dave Hughes, Lydia Ames, and finance director Brian Ayles. The group discussed deficit causes such as personnel costs, health insurance, and Essex Tech assessments, and brainstormed options including surveys, parking and meals tax increases, PILOT programs, early retirement incentives, and an efficiency audit. No votes or formal decisions were recorded, and the committee plans 8 to 9 meetings before issuing a first round of recommendations by early October.
